summary: This figure details the Klonet Controller, the core of Klonet's distributed orchestrator. It receives user requests through an External Service Interface at the top and interacts with the user management model through a Data Interface. Internally, a Local Task Executor (orange box) handles authentication and database queries such as User Register/Login and Get User/Scene/Node List, while a Cluster Task Dispatcher (orange box) assigns cluster-level tasks—virtual Network Embedding, Scene Loading, Cluster Monitor, Node/Link Configuration, Terminal Relay, and Traffic Generator—down to a Klonet Agent shown at the bottom edge. A small legend distinguishes solid control-flow arrows from dashed data-flow arrows. The figure frames the Controller as a hub with three external touch points and two internal, function-grouped modules.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Klonet 控制器：通过外部服务接口接收用户请求，经数据接口与用户管理模型交互，内部本地任务执行器负责鉴权与数据库查询，集群任务调度器则把网络嵌入、链路配置等任务下发给 Klonet 代理。
